F-grouse-walk-0079.name: 300 m NW of Redding Creek
F-grouse-walk-0079.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
F-grouse-walk-0079.parkWhat: pull off on Redding Creek FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: Road: Baribeau Creek FSR, 5.5 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS).
3 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.

flags.t: Route enters a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Baribeau Creek. Closed Year Round. Synopsis map 1-63/23.

CWD (Chronic Wasting Disease) Management Zone, MU 4-20: every deer, elk and moose taken here must have its head sampled at a CWD freezer before you leave the zone (www.gov.bc.ca/CWDdropoff). Brain and spinal column (vertebrae, not the tail) may not leave the zone: leave them at the kill site or a landfill in it (synopsis pages 15, 36, 37, 99%).

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 4 table (pages 39 and 40), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). Pages 36 to 41 print no LEH list.

plan: Drive: from Cranbrook, about 74 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via King St W, King St, Wycliffe Rd, Perry Creek Rd.
Park: 49.64453, -116.52849, pull off on Redding Creek FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: the Baribeau Creek FSR stretch, 5.5 km one way. About 109 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-20, Region 4. CWD zone: deer, elk and moose heads go to a CWD freezer; brain and spine stay in the zone. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-04, private land 2026-09-26, closures 2026-10-03.

plan: Drive: from Cranbrook, about 81 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.71784, -116.56713, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 5.1 km S, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 895 m, about 192 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 400 m S of the spot at 1,481 m (49.67069, -116.59105). Water: Baribeau Creek 110 m S (estimate).
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
